youtube.baslik: What is the most background noise allowed in an empty classroom? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The American national standard recommends that background noise in an empty classroom not exceed 35 dBA, and that reverberation time in small and medium classrooms not exceed about 0.6 to 0.7 seconds. As reverberation time grows, the echoes of syllables overlap and speech becomes blurred; simple measures such as carpets, sound-absorbing ceiling panels, curtains and felt pads on chair legs reduce reverberation and noise.
